basis: 1977 Factory LaScala Dimensions, two-page scan posted in Klipsch community; community copy, authenticity not independently certified
height_choice: Protected original cabinet remains 35-1/4 inches. User approved a separate 3/4-inch underlaid bottom, giving 36 inches complete height. This is an explicit R2 assembly interpretation, not a resolved factory overall-height dimension.
coordinate_system: mm; X centered, front Y=0, rear Y=622.3, original cabinet underside Z=0; removable cover spans Z=-19.05 to 0
uncertainties: Doghouse roof blank length/bevel notes do not fully reconcile with assembled section dimensions. R2 uses section geometry with continuous constant-thickness walls and fitted miters.

Rear wing faces now true 30 degrees, with original slot-edge starts unchanged. Air-face endpoints are 5.656687 mm short of floor/shelf corners at the motorboard side edge. Whether the factory wing stopped there or had a shifted start cannot be resolved from this scan.

Factory panel 11 is now the specified 23 x 23-1/2 inch rectangular underlay. User approved 3/4-inch thickness and 36-inch complete height. Source does not dimension thickness or exact XY offsets; R2 centers it under the cabinet. Gasket and screw details are not invented.

Midrange opening verified from drawing as 16-3/16 x 5-5/8 inches; no widening. Tweeter vertical offset remains interpreted from scan. Exact fastener holes, rebates, gaskets and joinery are not modeled.
All driver and horn shapes are approximate reference envelopes; lofts are not validated acoustic contours. No crossover, wiring or fasteners modeled.
Nominal 3/4-inch plywood modeled as 19.05 mm; measure actual stock before production.
